description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Cats and Squirrels, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
